system.description:
Forged in Mournas's underground resistance and street brawls — a scrapper who fights dirty and fights smart.

  • Street Grappler: Advantage on grapple and overbearing checks.
  • Underground Network: Advantage on checks navigating Mournas's underworld, recognising gang or faction markings, or finding allies in the criminal underground.
